newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to launch stock options trading on July 7.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to launch stock options trading on July 7.

text.p: South Korea will allow stock options trading from July 7, the Ministry of Finance and Economy said in a statement on Wednesday.
The Korea Stock Exchange will start a test run of the options trade from February 3, it said.
The ministry said that the launch of stock options trading was expected to reduce risk for investors and to allow more diversified portfolios at a lower cost.
In line with the new options trading, securities regulations would be revised during the first quarter of the year, the statement said.
